events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.
I'll write the whole scene as a single canvas-based `index.html`.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#050403;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;cursor:default}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in a dark, warmly lit room"></canvas>
<script>
(()=>{
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const mq=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let reduced=mq.matches;
const TAU=Math.PI*2,clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function mulberry(a){return()=>{a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
const rng=mulberry(7);

let W,H,DPR,R,cx,cy,ry,bx,by,brx,bry;
const P=(u,v)=>[bx+u*brx,by+v*bry];

/* ---------- sprites ---------- */
function sprite(rgb){
  const s=document.createElement('canvas');s.width=s.height=128;
  const g=s.getContext('2d'),gr=g.createRadialGradient(64,64,0,64,64,64);
  gr.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${rgb},1)`);gr.addColorStop(.35,`rgba(${rgb},.45)`);gr.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${rgb},0)`);
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,128,128);return s;
}
const steamSpr=sprite('255,238,222'),emberSpr=sprite('255,170,80');

/* ---------- static scene data ---------- */
const strands=[];
for(let i=0;i<26;i++)strands.push({a:rng()*TAU,r0:.2+rng()*.6,dir:rng()<.5?-1:1,turn:3.5+rng()*3,ph:rng()*TAU,tone:rng()});
const oil=[];for(let i=0;i<34;i++){const a=rng()*TAU,d=Math.sqrt(rng())*.88;oil.push({u:Math.cos(a)*d,v:Math.sin(a)*d,r:.012+rng()*rng()*.05,ph:rng()*TAU})}
const scallions=[];for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const a=rng()*TAU,d=Math.sqrt(rng())*.85;scallions.push({u:Math.cos(a)*d,v:Math.sin(a)*d*.9,r:.017+rng()*.008,ph:rng()*TAU})}
const sesame=[];for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const a=rng()*TAU,d=Math.sqrt(rng())*.85;sesame.push({u:Math.cos(a)*d,v:Math.sin(a)*d*.9,rot:rng()*TAU})}
const flakes=[];for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const a=rng()*TAU,d=Math.sqrt(rng())*.8;flakes.push({u:Math.cos(a)*d,v:Math.sin(a)*d*.9,rot:rng()*TAU,s:.008+rng()*.01})}
const embers=[];for(let i=0;i<50;i++)embers.push({x:rng(),y:rng(),r:.4+rng()*1.4,sp:.006+rng()*.02,ph:rng()*TAU,dr:rng()*2-1});

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let mxT=0,myT=0,ms={x:0,y:0},mpx=-1e4,mpy=-1e4,mvx=0,mvy=0,active=false,lastPx=0,lastPy=0,lastMoveT=0,lastRip=0;
const steam=[],ripples=[];let acc=0,ambT=1.5,raf=0,prev=0,clock=0;

function resize(){
  DPR=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;
  cv.width=Math.round(W*DPR);cv.height=Math.round(H*DPR);
  R=Math.min(W*.42,H*.4);cx=W/2;cy=H*.6;
  steam.length=0;ripples.length=0;
  if(reduced){presim();render(4)}
}
function geom(){
  ry=R*(.3+ms.y*.025);bx=cx;by=cy+ry*.1;brx=R*.93;bry=ry*.82;
}

/* ---------- steam ---------- */
function spawn(n,age){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rng()*TAU,d=Math.sqrt(Math.random())*.75;
    steam.push({x:bx+Math.cos(a)*d*brx,y:by+Math.sin(a)*d*bry-bry*.3,vx:0,vy:-R*(.16+Math.random()*.16),age:age||0,life:3.5+Math.random()*3,size:R*(.06+Math.random()*.05),ph:Math.random()*TAU});
  }
}
function stepSteam(dt,t){
  acc+=dt*(active?60:52);
  while(acc>=1){spawn(1);acc--}
  const rad=R*.9,sway=Math.sin(t*.3)*R*.03;
  for(let i=steam.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=steam[i];p.age+=dt;
    if(p.age>p.life||steam.length>450){steam.splice(i,1);continue}
    p.vx+=(Math.sin(p.y*.012*300/R+t*.7+p.ph)*R*.35+sway)*dt;
    p.vx*=1-.8*dt;
    if(active&&!reduced){
      const dx=p.x-mpx,dy=p.y-mpy,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      if(d<rad){const f=1-d/rad;p.vx+=(dx/d)*f*R*2.2*dt+mvx*f*.7*dt;p.vy+=(dy/d)*f*R*.6*dt+mvy*f*.3*dt}
    }
    p.vy+=(-R*.22-p.vy)*.4*dt;
    p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
  }
}
function presim(){
  geom();steam.length=0;acc=0;
  for(let i=0;i<360;i++)stepSteam(1/30,i/30);
}

/* ---------- drawing helpers ---------- */
function smooth(pts){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let k=1;k<pts.length-1;k++){const m=[(pts[k][0]+pts[k+1][0])/2,(pts[k][1]+pts[k+1][1])/2];ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[k][0],pts[k][1],m[0],m[1])}
  const l=pts[pts.length-1];ctx.lineTo(l[0],l[1]);
}
function bowlPath(){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-R,cy);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx-R,cy+R*.55,cx-R*.55,cy+R*.78,cx-R*.32,cy+R*.8);
  ctx.lineTo(cx+R*.32,cy+R*.8);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx+R*.55,cy+R*.78,cx+R,cy+R*.55,cx+R,cy);
  ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,R,ry,0,0,Math.PI,false);ctx.closePath();
}
function ell(x,y,rx,ryy,rot){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ryy,rot||0,0,TAU)}

function background(flick,lx,ly){
  let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#030202');g.addColorStop(.55,'#0b0705');g.addColorStop(1,'#070403');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const wx=cx-ms.x*R*.06;
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(wx,cy-R*.5,0,wx,cy-R*.5,R*2.8);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(150,62,18,${.30*flick})`);g.addColorStop(.5,`rgba(80,30,10,${.13*flick})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(cx,cy+R*.82);ctx.scale(1,.28);
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,R*2.4);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,140,55,${.24*flick})`);g.addColorStop(.4,`rgba(190,80,25,${.09*flick})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(-R*2.5,-R*2.5,R*5,R*5);ctx.restore();
}
function embersDraw(t){
  for(const e of embers){
    const y=((e.y-t*e.sp)%1+1)%1,x=((e.x+Math.sin(t*.2+e.ph)*.03+e.dr*t*.004-ms.x*.01*e.r)%1+1)%1;
    const near=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(y-.55)*1.6);
    const a=(.25+.75*(.5+.5*Math.sin(t*1.3+e.ph)))*(.15+near*.6)*.7;
    const s=e.r*(R/60)*2.2;
    ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.drawImage(emberSpr,x*W-s,y*H-s,s*2,s*2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function bowlBody(lx,flick){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0808';ell(cx,cy+R*.8,R*.33,R*.065);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,150,70,.25)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+R*.8,R*.33,R*.065,0,.1*Math.PI,.9*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();bowlPath();ctx.clip();
  const hx=clamp(.5+(lx-cx)/(2*R)*.55,.3,.7);
  let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(cx-R,0,cx+R,0);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0b0909');g.addColorStop(clamp(hx-.16,.05,.9),'#1c1719');g.addColorStop(hx,'#40353a');g.addColorStop(clamp(hx+.16,.1,.95),'#17120f');g.addColorStop(1,'#060505');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(cx-R,cy-ry,R*2,R*1.2);
  g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,cy,0,cy+R*.8);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,130,50,${.22*flick})`);g.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(255,120,40,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.4)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(cx-R,cy,R*2,R*.85);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#8c2c1a';ctx.lineWidth=R*.075;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+R*.2,R*1.02,ry,0,0,Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,150,110,.22)';ctx.lineWidth=R*.012;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+R*.2-R*.025,R*1.02,ry,0,0,Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5c1c12';ctx.lineWidth=R*.02;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+R*.3,R*1.0,ry,0,0,Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
  const sx=lx-(lx-cx)*.2;
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,cy+R*.25,0,sx,cy+R*.25,R*.5);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,240,225,.13)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,240,225,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(cx-R,cy,R*2,R);
  ctx.restore();
}

function bowlInterior(flick){
  let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,cy-ry,0,cy+ry);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#4a3b34');g.addColorStop(1,'#1c1512');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ell(cx,cy,R,ry);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,225,190,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,R,ry,0,Math.PI*1.08,Math.PI*1.92);ctx.stroke();
  ell(cx,cy,R*.955,ry*.9);
  g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,cy-ry,0,cy+ry);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0e0705');g.addColorStop(1,'#2a1409');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy-ry*.5,0,cx,cy-ry*.5,R*.8);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,140,50,${.28*flick})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,50,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ell(cx,cy,R*.955,ry*.9);ctx.fill();
}

function broth(t,lx,ly,flick){
  ctx.save();ell(bx,by,brx,bry);ctx.clip();
  let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(bx,by,0,bx,by,brx);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#d99a45');g.addColorStop(.55,'#b56d24');g.addColorStop(1,'#5e3010');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(bx-brx,by-bry,brx*2,bry*2);
  // noodles
  ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';
  for(const s of strands){
    const pts=[];
    for(let j=0;j<=36;j++){
      const q=j/36,th=s.a+q*s.dir*s.turn;
      const r=clamp(s.r0+.25*Math.sin(q*6+s.ph)+.025*Math.sin(t*.9+q*9+s.ph),.05,.97);
      pts.push(P(Math.cos(th)*r,Math.sin(th)*r));
    }
    const lw=R*.03;
    smooth(pts);ctx.strokeStyle=s.tone<.5?'#a9782f':'#9c6a26';ctx.lineWidth=lw*1.25;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-lw*.22);smooth(pts);
    ctx.strokeStyle=s.tone<.5?'#f0d089':'#e6bf72';ctx.lineWidth=lw*.8;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-lw*.4);smooth(pts);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,246,210,.28)';ctx.lineWidth=lw*.25;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
  }
  // broth tint over the bottom of the mat
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(bx,by,brx*.2,bx,by,brx);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(190,110,30,.05)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(70,30,8,.55)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(bx-brx,by-bry,brx*2,bry*2);
  // oil
  for(const d of oil){
    const [x,y]=P(d.u+.01*Math.sin(t*.3+d.ph),d.v+.01*Math.cos(t*.27+d.ph)),rr=d.r*R;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,205,110,.16)';ell(x,y,rr,rr*bry/brx);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,236,185,.38)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,240,.55)';ell(x-rr*.3,y-rr*.25*bry/brx,rr*.22,rr*.12);ctx.fill();
  }
  // ripples
  for(const r of ripples){
    const a=r.age,rad=a*R*.42,k=Math.max(0,1-a/2.4);
    for(let n=0;n<3;n++){
      const rr=rad-n*R*.045;if(rr<=0)continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,232,175,${.5*k*(1-n*.3)})`;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,R*.006);
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(r.x,r.y,rr,rr*bry/brx,0,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  // sheen
  const sx=bx+(lx-cx)*.35,sy=by-bry*.25+(ly-cy+R)*.05;
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,0,sx,sy,brx*.75);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,240,205,.28)');g.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(255,215,150,.09)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,215,150,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(bx-brx,by-bry,brx*2,bry*2);
  ctx.restore();
  // front lip
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,215,170,${.35+.1*flick})`;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1.2,R*.008);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,R*.958,ry*.905,0,.12*Math.PI,.88*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
}

/* ---------- toppings ---------- */
function leaf(x,y,ang,len,wd,c1,c2,vein){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(ang);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(wd*.6,-len*.2,wd,-len*.8,0,-len);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-wd,-len*.8,-wd*.6,-len*.2,0,0);
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-wd,0,wd,0);g.addColorStop(0,c1);g.addColorStop(.5,c2);g.addColorStop(1,c1);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
  if(vein){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(215,255,180,.4)';ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,R*.005);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-len*.05);ctx.lineTo(0,-len*.92);ctx.stroke()}
  ctx.restore();
}
function bokchoy(x,y,t){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y+Math.sin(t*1.0)*R*.003);
  const L=R*.36,ang=[-.55,-.05,.5,.2,-.3];
  ang.forEach((a,i)=>{
    const l=L*(i>2?.8:1);
    leaf(0,0,a,l*.6,R*.05,'#b9d79a','#e3f2c9');
    leaf(Math.sin(a)*l*.3,-Math.cos(a)*l*.3,a*1.15,l*.78,R*.1,'#2f6b2a','#5aa845',true);
  });
  ctx.restore();
}
function nori(x,y,t){
  const w=R*.3,h=R*.38,sk=R*.05;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y+Math.sin(t*1.1)*R*.003);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-w/2,0);ctx.lineTo(w/2,-R*.02);ctx.lineTo(w/2+sk,-h);ctx.lineTo(-w/2+sk,-h+R*.02);ctx.closePath();
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-w/2,0,w/2,0);g.addColorStop(0,'#070d0a');g.addColorStop(.5,'#1e3628');g.addColorStop(1,'#08110c');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(140,190,150,.12)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=1;i<9;i++){const px=-w/2+w*i/9;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,0);ctx.lineTo(px+sk,-h);ctx.stroke()}
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(170,230,180,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-w/2+sk,-h+R*.02);ctx.lineTo(w/2+sk,-h);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function tofu(x,y,s,rot,t,ph){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y+Math.sin(t*1.2+ph)*R*.003);ctx.rotate(rot);
  const T=[[-s,-s*.35],[0,-s*.7],[s,-s*.35],[0,0]];
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-s,-s*.35);ctx.lineTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(0,s*.9);ctx.lineTo(-s,s*.55);ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle='#c8a15c';ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(s,-s*.35);ctx.lineTo(s,s*.55);ctx.lineTo(0,s*.9);ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle='#a07a3e';ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(T[0][0],T[0][1]);T.slice(1).forEach(p=>ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]));ctx.closePath();
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-s*.7,0,0);g.addColorStop(0,'#e9cf96');g.addColorStop(1,'#f4e2b4');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,72,24,.75)';ctx.lineWidth=s*.09;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,240,200,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-s*.55,-s*.35);ctx.lineTo(0,-s*.05);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,110,30,.25)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-s,s*.55);ctx.lineTo(0,s*.9);ctx.lineTo(s,s*.55);ctx.lineTo(s,s*.35);ctx.lineTo(0,s*.7);ctx.lineTo(-s,s*.35);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function shiitake(x,y,s,t,ph){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y+Math.sin(t*1.05+ph)*R*.003);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2e170a';ell(0,s*.17,s,s*.55);ctx.fill();
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(-s*.3,-s*.25,0,0,0,s);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#a5703f');g.addColorStop(.55,'#63381a');g.addColorStop(1,'#33190a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ell(0,0,s,s*.55);ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();ell(0,0,s,s*.55);ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(230,200,150,.75)';ctx.lineWidth=s*.09;ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-s*.65,-s*.25);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,s*.05,s*.65,s*.25);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-s*.5,s*.3);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,-s*.05,s*.5,-s*.35);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,220,170,.3)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,s*.96,s*.52,0,Math.PI*1.1,Math.PI*1.7);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function corn(x,y,t){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
  const k=[[-.5,.1],[-.2,-.15],[.15,.05],[.45,-.1],[-.05,.25],[.3,.3],[-.4,.35],[.6,.2]];
  k.forEach((o,i)=>{
    const kx=o[0]*R*.09,ky=o[1]*R*.05+Math.sin(t*1.2+i)*R*.002,r=R*.02;
    ctx.fillStyle='#e8b422';ell(kx,ky,r,r*.75);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,246,170,.8)';ell(kx-r*.3,ky-r*.3,r*.35,r*.2);ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.restore();
}

function garnish(t){
  for(const s of scallions){
    const [x,y]=P(s.u+.008*Math.sin(t*.4+s.ph),s.v+.008*Math.cos(t*.35+s.ph)),r=s.r*R;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(190,230,140,.9)';ell(x,y,r,r*.55);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#3f8c34';ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.35);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,230,.5)';ell(x,y,r*.35,r*.2);ctx.fill();
  }
  for(const f of flakes){
    const [x,y]=P(f.u,f.v),s=f.s*R;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(f.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle='#c4321c';ctx.fillRect(-s,-s*.5,s*2,s);ctx.restore();
  }
  for(const s of sesame){
    const [x,y]=P(s.u,s.v);
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(s.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1e2c0';ell(0,0,R*.0075,R*.0042);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
  }
}

/* ---------- frame ---------- */
function render(t){
  geom();
  const flick=.9+.1*Math.sin(t*2.3)*Math.sin(t*.7+1)+.04*Math.sin(t*7.1),
        lx=cx+ms.x*R*.8,ly=cy-R*.9+ms.y*R*.3;
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  background(flick,lx,ly);
  embersDraw(t);
  // contact shadow
